reasons: Lake identity record confirms Mathis v. United States, U.S. Supreme Court, decided 1968-05-06, with expected citation found.
Lake citations record official citation 391 U.S. 1 and the listed parallel/vendor citations.
Treatment is caution/limited, not overruled or abrogated; disclosed treatment scope says the holding stands subject to Howes.
residual_risks: Lake status is under_review and treatment derivation includes audit_needed/cap_hit flags, but the disclosed judgment fields still support live-law existence with caution.

reasons: Lens B only: no support/quote challenge made.
Disclosed treatment scope states: "Holding stands: Miranda is not lost because in-custody questioning concerns a separate/unrelated matter" and then discloses the Howes limitation.
The page separately warns that incarceration alone is no longer enough after Howes, so the holding is not presented as unqualified current black-letter law.
residual_risks: The holding sentence could be overread if isolated from the treatment field.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: For standalone reuse, add a parenthetical that Howes requires a totality-of-circumstances custody analysis for inmate questioning.

reasons: Lens B only: no support/role challenge made.
The disclosed page and inventory both assign the home role "Key — Progeny / Refinement" under Miranda and Custodial Interrogation.
The caution/limited treatment is compatible with a progeny/refinement role rather than a simple current-rule label.
Lake identity court_level is scotus and court is U.S. Supreme Court.
A SCOTUS authority remains binding on surviving points despite the disclosed caution/limited treatment.
The page pairs the weight label with the limited-by-Howes treatment badge, avoiding an unqualified good-law signal.
residual_risks: Binding weight does not mean every broad reading remains valid; the Howes limitation must travel with the label.

reasons: Lake point_overrides contains point legacy-limited-mathis-v-united-states-1968 with field_i_validity caution and s3_binding_status provisional.

residual_risks: The override is expressly provisional and the derivation notes audit_needed, so it should not be upgraded to a final treatment call without further review.

reasons: The page treatment field matches the lake judgment: field_i_validity caution, as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, composite_basis migration-seed, varies_by_point true.

residual_risks: Lake derivation has cap_hit and audit_needed flags, so this should remain caution/provisional rather than a stronger good-law rating.
